The current draft proposes a Thursday 02:00 UTC canary for 60 minutes, followed by broad deployment on Friday. Before I can approve this plan, our release policy requires a final round-robin check with application platform, reliability, and compliance. I need each of those areas to weigh in with any required rollout changes. Once I've recorded everyone's required changes and confirmed they're included in the plan, I'll make the final approval decision. Who's representing application platform, reliability, and compliance here today?
